detail.longDescription:
Domotz is the all-in-one network monitoring and management platform trusted by MSPs, Integrators, Security Professionals, IT teams, and Business Owners to manage multiple networks and devices of any brand.

Cost-effectively monitor your customers' networks with plug-and-play setup, an intuitive UX, and a comprehensive feature set, accessible from any desktop browser or mobile device. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified, Domotz manages 40,000+ networks and 4M+ devices across 180+ countries.

PLEASE NOTE: This app REQUIRES the Domotz Collector to be installed on a network via the Domotz Box, or via self-install on Raspberry Pi, NAS (Synology, QNAP), Windows, Linux, or Docker.

• NETWORK DISCOVERY & INVENTORY: Get a full inventory of every IP device on the network in seconds. Layer-2 and Layer-3 device identification, automatic topology mapping, make/model/type qualification, and bulk asset management. Device heartbeat checked every 30 seconds via MAC address.

• REMOTE DEVICE ACCESS: Web, Remote Desktop, and Console Access (HTTP/S, RDP, SSH, Telnet) plus secure VPN on-demand to reach any device on the remote network.

• REMOTE POWER MANAGEMENT: Manage device power remotely (On/Off/Reboot) on the most popular IP-controllable PDUs, UPS, smart plugs, and PoE switches.

• SNMP & OS MONITORING: Pre-configured SNMP templates (v1/v2/v3) and OS sensors for servers, NAS, workstations, switches, firewalls, and access points, with configurable thresholds and historical graphs.

• PROFILES: Apply and replicate configurations across many devices in just a few clicks. A Profile is a reusable bundle of modules — device Info (Type, Important flag, Location, Zone), Credentials (SNMP v1/v2/v3), Shared Alerts, SNMP sensors, and TCP sensors — that can be applied in Overwrite or Additive mode, ensuring consistent monitoring, standardized alerting, and faster onboarding across your entire infrastructure.

• NETWORK MAPPING / PoE / SWITCH MONITORING: Automatic detection of which devices are connected to individual ports of a managed switch. Monitor port traffic, packet loss, and errors, and shut down or power-cycle individual ports.

• ALERTS & NOTIFICATIONS: Real-time alerts for network down, device down, new device joined, configuration changes, SNMP/OS thresholds, and security events. Deliver alerts through multiple contact channels: Email, Push Notifications, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, custom Webhooks, and leading PSA/ticketing systems including Autotask, ConnectWise, ServiceNow, HaloPSA, Syncro, Zendesk, and Freshservice.

• NETWORK DIAGNOSTICS: Bandwidth analysis, internet speed tests, route quality, latency, jitter, packet loss, and DHCP/IP conflict detection.

• MULTI-VLAN & MULTI-SUBNET: Monitor multiple VLANs and subnets (up to /16) from a single Collector, including additional subnets reachable over VPN.

• SECURITY: Continuous perimeter scanning for open ports, vulnerability detection, two-factor authentication (2FA) with team enforcement, and SSO/SAML support.

• CONFIGURATION BACKUP: Automatic backup and restore for network device configurations, with alerting on configuration changes.

• OT & IoT MONITORING: Monitor IP cameras (ONVIF) with snapshots, UPS/PDUs, access control, digital signage, AV systems, building automation, printers, POS, and industrial IoT.

• AUTOMATION & EXTENSIBILITY: Public API, Webhooks, custom scripting/drivers, and 1,000+ third-party integrations to fit any workflow.

• DASHBOARD: Multi-tenant dashboard to troubleshoot and monitor all live Collectors across every network you manage, with role-based access control, audit logs, and automated reporting.
